excerpt.zh: 在已经流逝的数千年的某个时间，发生了一次严重的撞击事件，一颗矿物丰富的小行星与[From.GetName]相撞。现在，[From.GetPlanetMoon]的撞击坑周围仍能找到丰富的矿物储藏。
excerpt.en: A large mineral-rich asteroid collided with [From.GetName] at some point during the previous thousand years in what must have been a major impact event. An abundance of minerals can now be found on the [From.GetPlanetMoon] in the vicinity of the impact crater.
